diffs.diff: header pin 9: part says A7, datasheet reading says A0
diffs.evidence: Adafruit #5836 board file (Adafruit ADS7830 Breakout PCB.brd): the analog header JP2 (1X08, rot R180, centre x=15.24) carries front silkscreen labels left to right 'A7' x=6.35, 'A6' 8.89, 'A5' 11.43, 'A4' 13.97, 'A3' 16.51, 'A2' 19.05, 'A1' 21.59, 'A0' 24.13, directly above the other header JP3 whose silk reads VIN(6.35) GND SCL SDA REF COM AD0 AD1(24.257). Nets confirm it: JP2 pad 1 = A0 ... pad 8 = A7, and with R180 pad 1 sits at x=24.13 (right end), so reading the board left to right gives A7..A0. The model lists the 16 pins in that physical silkscreen order (VIN..AD1 then A7..A0); the second reading simply listed the analog row in numeric A0..A7 order. Every pin keeps the same name and function either way, and wiring is by label, so no fix is needed.
